bluf: The SEO Works is an employee owned Sheffield search agency (founded 2009, 80+ staff) that has moved its front door to AI search: GEO, AEO, ChatGPT advertising and free AI visibility audits sit beside SEO and PPC. The record shows it going where the citation goes, with dated AI Overview and LLM referral case studies through 2026-07-01 and an llms.txt on its own site. Horus reads it Neutral at -2, best placed for KJ1 and most exposed to KJ4. The one thing a rival should know: it sells paid social with no social pixel on its own site, publishes no pricing, and the record lists no moves, news or jobs.
doing:
The positioning line, a search focused growth partner for leading brands, mid market firms and SMEs integrating SEO, GEO, digital PR, paid media and web, decodes to a full service search shop for a mixed client base that has renamed its front door for AI answers. The headline claim, that AI search work for DHL lifted AI Overview citations 287% and grew ChatGPT referrals, is the agency's claim; the DHL case study title itself puts LLM referrals at 121%.

Three lines lead at score 3: AI Search / GEO (GEO, AEO and AI SEO services, the DHL case study, a free AI visibility audit), Paid Search (Google Ads, Shopping and Amazon PPC pages; an accredited Google Ads agency) and SEO (the homepage title and H1 brand it a UK SEO company and the next gen SEO company). Core at score 2: Content & Digital PR (a digital PR page linking PR to AI visibility), Paid Social (a kitchen appliance case study) and Web & Product (about 15 build case studies). Family scores: Search & AI visibility 3.87, Performance media 2.9, Data & measurement 0. Proprietary products: Growth Intelligence and a downloadable ChatGPT Visibility Tracker.

AI posture: AI search is the headline line, ChatGPT advertising and free AI visibility audits from in house tech included, with an LLM facing information page and an llms.txt describing the firm.

Recent moves: the record lists none and no news; the dated activity is case studies, in order the DHL AI search campaign (2026-02-09), pool rental AI Overview visibility up 56% (2026-06-19), 60% of AI Overviews for a seating manufacturer (2026-06-22) and a Meadow Bay Villages content strategy with revenue up over 102% (2026-07-01), figures as the titles claim.

The record lists no pricing model. Conspicuously absent for a search agency of 80+ people: any data and measurement line, any owned audience or CRM line, any jobs or ATS (jobs count 0), and any named partner beyond the Google Ads accreditation.
clients:
The client type is mixed; verticals listed are Healthcare, SaaS & software, Ecommerce, Education, Finance, Manufacturing, Automotive, Logistics and Homeware; the home market is the UK from Sheffield, plus a Philadelphia office. The healthcare page claims it is the only company on the NHS national supply framework for digital marketing and web design.

The needs read names 9 clients, 9 observed and 0 names only, all from case studies, none shared with another tracked agency. DHL came for AI and automation, organic demand and brand (AI Search Campaign for DHL Increases LLM Referrals by 121%, 2026-02-09). St James's Place came for organic demand (Over 100 Page One Rankings, 2018-06-20). Dainese for organic demand and commerce (eCommerce SEO Campaign, 2018-06-12). Absolute Reg for organic demand (Organic Revenue up 215% in Automotive Sector, 2023-04-27, over 1,000 page one rankings for a private number plate provider). GeoPura for web build (the sustainable energy website slug). Four rows are category titles the read treats as clients: Higher Education (organic demand, an international university, 2020-05-06), Framework Web Design (web, organic and brand, 2017-07-03), Charity Web Design (brand and web; the excerpt names Heart Research UK) and School Website Design UK (brand and web, 2018-06-12). The mix read: organic demand 0.411, web build 0.247, brand 0.219.

The 2026 AI case studies (pool rental, seating manufacturer, Meadow Bay Villages) name no client the read could code, so the newest work is the least attributable; the deepen pass counted 82 case studies against the 9 the read names.

What the base needs next, tied to KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation): very likely, moderate confidence, the organic demand accounts need citation share and LLM referral reporting, which it already sells; likely, low confidence, the web build category clients from 2017 and 2018 are no longer active.
house: Say and do: 4 of 5 tested lines pass. AI Search / GEO corroborated (llms.txt, 23 AI topic URLs); Paid Search corroborated (38 own Google ads, 30 in the last 30 days); LinkedIn advertising corroborated (24+); Paid Social contradicted, the one gap flagged: it sells paid social and runs no social ad pixel on its own site. market:
Horus reads The SEO Works Neutral at -2, percentile 17, resilience 34.2, 16:55 on the Solar Arc (dusk, Atum), best fit The Toll Road at 42/100. Best placed for KJ1, the click is being replaced by the citation (net 0.35, AI Search / GEO driving), and KJ2, ads inside AI answers (net 0.263). Most exposed to KJ4, the platforms are absorbing the execution layer (net -0.394, Paid Search and Paid Social), and KJ6, the agency middle is being hollowed out (net -0.338). Monsoon reads Onshore wind at 59.6, percentile 67: displacement 61.1 above migration 58.1, so price displacement by an offshore rival is the larger risk. 58 of the index is the sold mix, SEO (14) and Paid Search (9) the most movable hours, and automation overlaps 22% of them. Shore: 65% South and Southeast Asia, 20% Eastern Europe, 15% Africa and the Maghreb. No hub offices are listed, so the footprint is inferred; it claims in house delivery in its own words.
openings:
The strongest opening is price: displacement 61.1 on the Monsoon read, SEO and paid search hours an offshore delivered rival can undercut line by line, against a firm that publishes no pricing (P5 unknown) and claims in house delivery. A transparent outcome priced SEO and GEO offer likely (moderate confidence) wins the mid market and SME end of its mixed book. Falsifier: a published rate card or outcome priced offer on seoworks.co.uk, or a Radar compile listing a delivery hub.

In paid media the contradiction to lead with: it sells paid social and runs no social ad pixel on its own site, P4 is partial and Data & Measurement scores 0, so a rival showing first party data and measurement depth very likely takes the paid social and PPC accounts first, since KJ4 removes those hours.

Its lead line is hard to beat head on (P1 making, llms.txt and 23 AI URLs real, 2026 citation case studies). The contestable gap is P2, absent: no feed, schema or entity work in the record, so a rival can sell the machine readable layer under its GEO claims (likely, low confidence). The category web builds from 2017 and 2018 are old: roughly even chance they are open to a new bid.

I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk behind KJ1.
I7, holiday 2026 agentic checkout volume and merchant opt out rates, December 2026 to January 2027: disclosed AI checkout GMV deepens the KJ4 headwind on its paid search and paid social lines.
I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, October 2026: outcome pricing at a top five holdco would raise the cost of its unknown P5.

Follow the DHL AI search case study (dated 2026-02-09, lastmod 2026-05-05): a refreshed figure reconciling the 287% citations claim with the 121% referrals title would show whether the headline is being maintained.
